relationships.subject: eMCS
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed significantly higher activation of SST+ INs compared with non-SST INs following eMCS.

relationships.subject: S1 SST+ interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition of PNs or activation of SST+ INs, which inhibit LV-PNs activity, has been shown to reduce chronic pain responses

relationships.subject: VIP+ interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: This increase in the PNs activity is partly attributed to reduced activity of SST+ INs, which is mediated by stronger inhibition from vasoactive intestinal peptide-positive (VIP+) INs

relationships.subject: eMCS
relationships.evidence_quote: While sensitivity remained high in the CCI group, the CCI + eMCS group recovered to levels comparable with those of the sham group

key_findings: eMCS in M1 produced analgesia lasting at least 2 d and selectively activated SST+ INs in S1 while reducing LV-PN activation.
Causal role of S1 SST+ INs not yet established.
